snippet.title: Tandem Together Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Two idiots. One tandem. A load of suspicious cargo. Deliver the goods, sample the merchandise for wild power-ups, and try not to crash while you make your way across tricky terrains in this two-player co-op adventure with lots of physics-based chaos that will test your friendship.

Wishlist the Game Tandem Together on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/5036280/Tandem_Together/?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=pagerelease
